rules.adaptation: Second jump press and 20 held frames; native directional landing boost/cap. Water halves launch. Six earned Sonic 1 emeralds or session-only 4-1-2-6 unlock, 50 rings, separate X/touch transform control. Transformation uses the existing classic warp cue; Drop Dash release reuses the existing release samples.
